research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: LayerZero Labs is engaged in developing trustless omnichain communication protocol platforms, focusing on operations that enable the transmission of data items between source and destination nodes across different blockchains. Their research centers on facilitating secure and efficient messaging between decentralized applications operating on multiple blockchains. This work highlights LayerZero Labs’ focus on cross-chain communication and interoperability within blockchain ecosystems.

about_short_description.short_description: LayerZero Labs is a blockchain messaging protocol developer that allows decentralized applications build across multiple blockchains.

product.name: LayerZero Protocol
product.description: A blockchain messaging protocol enabling decentralized applications to send data across multiple blockchains with censorship resistance and permissionless infrastructure.

product.name: OApp (Omnichain Application)
product.description: A generic message passing interface for developers to send and receive arbitrary data between smart contracts on different blockchains.

product.name: OFT (Omnichain Fungible Token)
product.description: A token standard that allows fungible tokens to be transferred across multiple blockchains without wrapping or liquidity pools.

product.name: lzRead
product.description: A data primitive that allows smart contracts to access onchain data from any supported blockchain in a single function call.

product.name: lzCatalyst
product.description: An ecosystem program that supports the development of projects built on LayerZero by connecting builders with venture capital firms.

product.name: Console
product.description: A monitoring platform by LayerZero to help asset issuers configure bridge security and detect risky deployments.
